mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, category_id, status FROM product WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.id as p_id, p.name as p_name, p.price as p_price, p.category_id as p_category_id, p.status as p_status, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.description as c_description FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, price, category_id, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{categoryId}, #{status, typeHandler=com.example.mybatis.handler.ProductStatusTypeHandler})
